title: Motor vehicle service and repair information sharing scheme
summary: From 1 July 2022 car manufacturers must make service and repair information available to independent repairers on the same terms as dealers.

instruments.title: Competition and Consumer Amendment (Motor Vehicle Service and Repair Information) Act 2021
instruments.provisions: Competition and Consumer Act 2010 Part IVE

direction_rationale: Access to repair information lets independent repairers compete with dealer networks, which should lower repair prices.
comparison: Repair prices against other services; vehicles built before 2002, buses and heavy vehicles excluded
price_series: Maintenance and repair of motor vehicles

verified.notes: Date from the ACCC's scheme page.

review.notes: Drafted by AI-assisted desk research on 18 October 2026 (legislation gap scan, docs/legislation_gap_scan.md) from the sources cited. Not yet checked by a person: verify dates, industries and the direction hypothesis before use.

assessment.summary: Car makers must give independent repairers the same service and repair information as dealers. Independents can compete with dealer networks: a right-to-repair reform.

marks.reason: Lets independent repairers compete with dealers for servicing and repairs.
Access to repair data and tools spreads the ability to service new vehicle technology.

responsible.note: Administers the Competition and Consumer Act 2010 (except Parts given to other Ministers).
